mails.subject: Fwd: Demande d'interview et supplément partenaires
mails.body:
Je pense qu'on doit répondre, mais attention à la partie publicitaire. Tu t'en occupes ?

---------- Message transféré ----------
De : Étienne Marchetti <e.marchetti@revue-tidevand.example>

Bonjour,

Je suis rédacteur en chef de la Revue Tidevand, un magazine trimestriel consacré aux nouveaux lieux de travail dans le nord de l'Europe. Nous préparons un dossier sur les espaces de coworking indépendants et aimerions consacrer deux pages à Sluseholm Works, avec une interview de votre responsable et quelques photos.

Cette parution est gratuite et sans contrepartie. En parallèle, nous éditons un supplément « Partenaires » avec encarts publicitaires (à partir de 900 EUR la demi-page), que nous vous présentons à titre indicatif uniquement.

Seriez-vous disponible pour un entretien téléphonique de 30 minutes d'ici la mi-octobre ?

Bien cordialement,
Étienne Marchetti
mails.justification: A magazine editor proposes a free press feature, with an optional ad rate that looks like a sales pitch; it is a genuine press request forwarded for a reply within the week.

mails.subject: Heating on the 2nd floor, still broken
mails.body:
Hello,

This is my third message about the heating in the east wing of the second floor. It has been 14 degrees in our corner since last Monday, and three of us have been working in coats.

I am paying DKK 2,400 a month for a private studio, and I think a partial refund of DKK 600 for the cold weeks is fair. I would also like someone to come and look at the radiator, not just bleed it again.

If this is not solved by the end of the week we will have to look at moving out. I would rather not, we like the place, but we cannot work like this. Please tell me when a technician can come.

Jakob, Frisk & Fennel
mails.justification: A paying member reports an ongoing heating fault and asks for a fix and a refund; the exit threat and money make it sound hostile, but it is a genuine complaint needing a reply within 24 hours.

mails.subject: stuck outside!! 😬
mails.body:
Hi team!! 👋

So sorry to write on a Saturday morning, but I'm standing in front of the main door and my card isn't opening it. I'm a member (desk 6, Brogaard Ceramics, I've been with you since February) and I have a kiln delivery arriving at 9 that I have to receive inside.

I tried my card on the reader about ten times. The little light goes orange instead of green, which I've never seen before. I also tried the code on the keypad, same story. I wonder if the system had an update overnight? 🤔

There's one more thing that worried me. When I came around the back to try the delivery door, it was standing open with no one around. I closed it, but I think someone should look at it, in case something got taken or the lock is broken. I didn't go in.

I know you may not read this until Monday, so I'm also going to try calling the number on the door sticker. If you see this first, please let me in or tell me who has the master key!

Also, small bonus question: the email with the link to reactivate cards that I got last week, is that really from you? I didn't click it because it looked a bit odd. 🙈

Thank you so much!!
Elsa ☺️
mails.justification: A member is locked out on a Saturday morning with a delivery due and found an open back door, so it needs same-day action; the odd link she mentions is her own caution, not a solicitation.

mails.subject: Harbour District Forum: Autumn Bulletin
mails.body:
Dear subscribers,

The Harbour District Business Forum is pleased to present its Autumn Bulletin. You are receiving this because your organisation registered for our bulletin in March 2026.

1. Annual Members' Assembly
The Assembly will be held on 12 November at 17:00 at Pakhus Hall. The agenda and the proposed budget are attached to the digital edition. Registration is encouraged, though not required, and the fee for non-members is DKK 250.

2. Quayside lighting works
Works on the quayside lighting between Bridge 3 and Bridge 5 will start on 19 October and last approximately four weeks. Pedestrian access will be maintained at all times.

3. Call for proposals: the Winter Market
Local businesses and shared workspaces may submit stall proposals until 30 October using the form on our site. Selected participants receive a subsidised stall.

4. Sponsorship opportunities
Our partners programme offers visibility in the bulletin and at the Assembly. A rate card is available on request.

5. A word of thanks
The Forum thanks all the organisations that opened their doors during the Harbour Open Week in September. More than 600 visitors attended. No reply to this message is necessary.

6. Next bulletin
The December issue will cover the results of the member survey and the calendar for 2027.

Yours faithfully,
The Secretariat
Harbour District Business Forum
mails.justification: A formal bulletin the space registered for, with sponsorship and fee mentions that sound commercial, but it is a subscribed newsletter with a thank-you and nothing to answer.

mails.subject: Fwd: Interesse i skrivebord
mails.body:
Kan du tage den her? Hun nævner vores nyhedsbrev, så hun er sikkert varm. /Rasmus

---------- Videresendt besked ----------
Fra: Ida Lundqvist <ida.lundqvist@lundqvist-ux.example>
Dato: 22. september 2026

Hej Sluseholm Works,

Jeg har læst jeres nyhedsbrev i et halvt års tid (jeg tilmeldte mig efter jeres åbent hus i foråret), og nu er jeg endelig klar til at tage skridtet. Jeg er freelance UX-designer og arbejder lige nu fra køkkenbordet i Amager, hvilket ikke er holdbart.

Jeg kunne godt tænke mig at høre:
- Hvad koster et fast skrivebord om måneden, og er moms inkluderet?
- Er der ledige pladser i øjeblikket, helst i et roligt område?
- Kan jeg prøve en enkelt dag, før jeg binder mig? I nyhedsbrevet i august stod der noget om en gratis prøvedag.
- Hvor lang er opsigelsen?

Jeg ville helst starte 1. november, men er fleksibel. Hvis I har en uge i oktober, hvor jeg kan komme og kigge, er det også fint. Jeg har ikke travlt i denne uge.

I nyhedsbrevet nævnte I også, at der skulle komme en ny hylde til lokale kunstnere. Er den på plads? Det er mest af nysgerrighed.

Tak på forhånd!

Mange hilsner
Ida Lundqvist
www.lundqvist-ux.example
mails.justification: A prospective member who follows the newsletter asks about prices, trial day and desk availability, forwarded for a reply; newsletter references are secondary and the request is for the coming week.
